svg.title: The measurement
svg.desc: "After they leave" is the last sample, 145 seconds after the last agent left its tab. "Before" is commit 2ff860c. Hiding alone gave back 4 to 9% of the abandoned tabs' memory and almost all of their CPU; closing them gave back the memory. On its own, turning off the back-forward cache took 4 tabs that had each visited 6 pages (plus the working tab) from 3.4 GB to 1.3 GB.
